project_type.description: The entries whose people get thanked when they're published (projects, pieces, releases).

people_field.description: Its field naming the people who helped: their entries' slugs, comma-separated.

person_type.description: The entry type of people (collaborators, makers, guests).

consent_field.description: Their yes/no field: ticked when they're happy to be tagged. Anyone without it ticked is left out.

handle_field.description: Their field with the handle to tag (e.g. @ada@mastodon.social).

draft_entry_type.description: The entry type the thank-you is drafted as.
